scope: Generalization research following the historical 333-fit and 275-fit rounds
fit_definition: Fresh learner optimization/refit counts once; PCA/PLS counted separately. Existing-score readouts, fusion vectors, epochs and optimizer steps are not learner fits.
score_interpretation: Pooled OOF selection is exploratory. Nested diagnostics evaluate an inner-only choice where recorded; none of these are untouched test estimates.

families.label: Fixed-seed group-network stability
families.training_scope: Shared three-fold training OOF, with question-level folds; selection-conditional estimate
families.conclusion: The fixed four-seed full-question ensemble wins its two-variant training screen; no individual seed is chosen from validation.
families.fit_accounting: 2 variants × 3 folds × 4 fixed seeds + 4 selected full-training members = 28; previous epoch14 held fixed.

families.label: Context-conditioned pair comparison
families.training_scope: Shared three-fold training OOF, with question-level folds; selection-conditional estimate
families.conclusion: The fixed pooled-OOF winner achieves 1741/2114. Choosing each outer fold's recipe exclusively on its inner holdout yields 1732/2114; this stricter nested diagnostic reuses existing fits and is reported separately.
families.fit_accounting: 4 recipes × 3 folds × (inner stopping + fresh outer refit) + 1 full refit = 25; PCA32/64 shared across L2 values, 13 PCA fits.

families.label: Local condition correspondence
families.training_scope: Shared three-fold training OOF, with question-level folds; selection-conditional estimate
families.conclusion: The 54 local correspondence features do not improve matching base75 controls: 1663→1651 at 15 leaves and 1661→1654 at 31 leaves. The selected condition+PLS8 tree reaches 1719/2114, but this does not isolate a benefit from condition features; no matched PLS-only design is added after seeing results.
families.fit_accounting: 6 recipes × 3 folds + 1 full refit + 1 separate timing-probe tree = 20; 4 PLS fits. Recorded main-stage seconds exclude the earlier probe invocation.

families.label: Five-source finite score fusion
families.training_scope: Shared three-fold training OOF, with question-level folds; selection-conditional estimate
families.conclusion: The selected 0.25F+0.50P+0.25C reaches 1781/2114 versus F's 1778, with fold gains +1/−1/+3. It fails the predeclared +8 pooled and positive-every-fold gate; no fusion validation evaluation is performed.

training_gate.interpretation: Predeclared exploration threshold, not a significance test

families.fit_accounting: 70 quarter-step weight vectors over fixed D/F/P/C/S scores; all base models reused, 0 new learner fits.

source_evidence_addendum.scope: Append-only explanation of a mutable verification metadata hash; original fusion source_evidence.json is not replaced
source_evidence_addendum.reason: The already prepared train-input-only verification script was copied from runs/conditional_pair/verify_selected.py to the publicly reproducible top-level conditional_pair_verify.py. Only its CODE/OUT path calculation was changed. Running the new entry point reran diagnostic checks and overwrote selected_checks.json, including its measured inference time. This metadata file had previously been included in the immutable fusion source snapshot.
source_evidence_addendum.interpretation: The changed hash belongs to a timing/check record, not a changed learner, transform, score column or checkpoint. The original snapshot hash is retained as the evidence of the file that existed when fusion was selected.
source_evidence_addendum.reproduction_order: Complete conditional_pair_verify.py and other mutable diagnostic checks before generalization_fusion.py captures source_evidence.json. Later diagnostic reruns must be documented in an addendum; never replace the original source snapshot to conceal a change.

independent_reconstruction_review.group_ce_note: Independent exact arithmetic group means versus source float32 group weights

findings.detail: A bound metadata file changed after screening. Preserve the historical source evidence and document the later addition separately; do not silently rebind selection.

independent_reconstruction_review.interpretation: The implementation and saved failed gate agree with the registered 70-vector protocol. OOF figures remain post-selection training evidence. Source-integrity findings are reported separately.

families.label: Training error mechanisms
families.training_scope: Descriptive analysis of already selected training OOF outputs; no new learner or tuning decision
families.conclusion: Among 2114 hard training questions, all seven selected learned scorers miss 172; 120 of those have no detected error among the explicitly checked arithmetic. The parser checks only a limited arithmetic subset, so this is evidence of a diagnostic blind spot, not proof that all steps are correct. The oracle union requires correctness labels and is not an implementable selector.
families.fit_accounting: Reuse existing OOF scores and training inputs; 0 model fits and 0 validation evaluations.

families.label: Nested selective routing
families.training_scope: Shared three-fold training OOF, with question-level folds; selection-conditional estimate
families.conclusion: The inner-selected routing procedure reaches 1781/2114 against the newly matched F's 1771, with nested fold gains +4/+5/+1. The separately chosen final q20 rule also reaches 1781, but its historical-F gate sees only +3 over 1778, with fold gains −1/+1/+3; the required +8 and all-positive condition fails, so no routing validation is performed. All 77 F/G disagreements are routed to G, making the final answers identical to fixed G on these OOF questions: this experiment shows no additional answer-selection benefit from gating beyond that fixed comparator. The nested estimate remains conditional on the previously selected base recipes, weights and routing hypothesis.
families.fit_accounting: 3 outer folds × (3 inner folds × 5 fresh base learners + 5 matched outer refits) = 60 base fits. The three routing rules are compared in four selection collections (12 rule readouts); no meta-learner or full-training base refit is added. Learned transforms: 24 PCA and 24 PLS fits.

independent_routing_review.static_boundary_evidence: A/P fit receives only fitting eligible arrays; K fit/design/gamma only fitting slices; Q/C PLS and tree helpers select local_fit then eligible rows; held labels never enter fit, transform, scale or inner rule choice.
independent_routing_review.inference: The low-margin rule chooses the same parsed answers as fixed G on this OOF bank; this is no demonstrated selective-decision advantage over G.

selectivity_check.interpretation: Report these two policies separately. Both happen to route all 77 F/G disagreements and agree with fixed G on every parsed answer in this OOF sample.

interpretation_checks.interpretation: All 77 F/G parsed-answer disagreements are routed in this outer OOF sample. Both selected and nested routing therefore produce the same parsed answers as fixed G here. The positive matched-reference gain does not establish an additional benefit from selective routing; the historical-reference acceptance gate failed.

wall_time_caveat: Sum of recorded main stages; not elapsed project time or CPU-seconds. Concurrent work, probes recorded separately, metadata reconstruction and verification are not uniformly included.
